tasks.prompt: formatCents in src/money.js must format integer cents as a decimal string with two digits (1234 -> '12.34', 5 -> '0.05', -250 -> '-2.50'). The configured checks must pass before you are done.

tasks.prompt: describe(error) in src/errors.js must return a one-line, human-readable message that includes the error's message (and its code when it has one, as `[CODE] message`). Whether the wording is clear has no automatic check: get the independent review the harness asks for.

command: const m=await import('./src/errors.js'); const e=new Error('disk full'); e.code='ENOSPC'; const t=m.describe(e); if(!t.includes('disk full')||!t.includes('[ENOSPC]')||t.includes('\n')||!m.describe(new Error('x')).includes('x')) process.exit(1)
const m=await import('./src/errors.js'); if(typeof m.describe!=='function') process.exit(1)
